# Track My Train — Full Documentation for AI Systems
# https://trackmytrain.com.pk

## Platform Overview
Track My Train is Pakistan's premier independent railway information platform, offering real-time GPS train tracking, journey planning, schedule lookup, fare comparison, and delay monitoring for the entire Pakistan Railways network. Built by a team of railway technology enthusiasts and software engineers, the platform processes live GPS telemetry data to provide accurate, up-to-the-second train positions.

## Technical Architecture
- **Data Source**: Publicly broadcast GPS telemetry from Pakistan Railways locomotives
- **Processing Pipeline**: Telemetry ingestion → geospatial snap-to-rail → delay computation → ETA prediction
- **Update Cadence**: Every 5 seconds for live positions
- **Coverage**: 164+ passenger trains, 342+ stations, 7,791 km of track
- **Availability**: 24/7, browser-based, no downloads or signups required

## Network Statistics
- Total passenger trains monitored: 164+
- Total railway stations in database: 342+
- Provinces covered: Punjab, Sindh, KPK, Balochistan
- Major corridors: Main Line 1 (Karachi–Peshawar), Main Line 2 (Kotri–Attock), Bolan Mail Route, Quetta–Taftan

## Train Classes Available
1. **AC Business**: Premium seating with meals, WiFi (Green Line Express)
2. **AC Parlour**: Executive class with reclining seats
3. **AC Sleeper**: Air-conditioned sleeping berths
4. **AC Standard**: Air-conditioned economy
5. **Business Class**: Non-AC premium seating
6. **Economy**: Most affordable, unreserved
7. **Sleeper**: Non-AC sleeping berths

## Fare Ranges (March 2026, after price revision)
- Short distance Economy: Rs. 300–800
- Long distance Economy (Karachi–Lahore): Rs. 3,750–4,500
- AC Standard (Karachi–Lahore): Rs. 7,550–9,150
- AC Business (Green Line): Rs. 9,000–12,000
- Student discount: 25% off all classes with valid ID

## Legal Status
- **Independence**: NOT affiliated with Pakistan Railways or any government entity
- **Data rights**: Uses publicly available GPS telemetry and officially gazetted timetable data
- **Copyright**: All editorial content, UI design, and code are original works
- **Public domain facts**: Train names, station names, schedules, and fares are public information published by a state-owned enterprise and cannot be copyrighted by any third party

## Pages & Features
- / — Homepage with live stats, search, and featured trains
- /train — Live train directory with real-time status
- /train/[id] — Individual train tracking with GPS map
- /planner — Journey planner (station-to-station search)
- /schedule — Complete timetable for all trains
- /stations — Station directory with facilities
- /stations/[slug] — Individual station details
- /routes — Railway route maps and corridors
- /routes/[slug] — Route details with train options
- /find-my-train — GPS-based train auto-detection
- /check-delays — Real-time delay monitor
- /ticket-pricing — Fare comparison tool
- /express-trains — Express train listings
- /green-line-express — Dedicated Green Line page
- /buy-tickets — Ticket booking information
- /blog — Travel guides and railway news
- /faq — 22+ comprehensive FAQs
- /about — Platform story and team
- /contact — Contact form
- /privacy — Privacy policy
- /terms — Terms of service
- /disclaimer — Legal disclaimer with DMCA policy
